name: Schezwan classic chutney
ingredients_raw: Water, Sugar, Refined Sunflower Oil, lodized Salt, Onion, Tomato Paste, Garlic, Chilli (2%), Thickener (INS 1422), Corn Starch, Yeast Extract, Flavour Enhancer (INS 635), Soya Sauce Powder [Anticaking Agent (INS 551)], Ginger, Paprika Oleoresin, Acidity Regulator (INS 260), Flavours Natural Flavouring Substances), Spices (White Pepper (0.1%) & Celery Seed Powder), Stabilizer (INS 415), Sichuan Pepper Powder, Preservative (INS 211) and Colour (INS 150d).
